title: Entity Solr Document (v3)
description: Schema for entity documents produced by the v3 importers and according to the new representation  (Impresso Project). The entity document is a Solr document containing frequency and identifier fields, and it is the canonical representation of an entity in the Impresso Project. [CODEX please complete]

id.description: Unique Wikidata identifier of the entity.

default_label_s.description: The default label of the entity, chosen from the available labels. Default selection is English label → accepted language-specific label matching `wkpedia_lg` → accepted other-language label → Wikipedia page name.

entitySuggest.description: Optional Solr suggester field documenting the labels exposed for entity auto-completion. It is populated by Solr configuration and is absent from generated documents. In other words: present only once indexed.

ner_entity_type_s.description: One NER type selected by the importer as the most frequent predicted type among accepted occurrences linked to this QID. Tie resolution is importer-defined; this field records one selected type and does not use a mixed value.

content_item_count_l.description: Number of distinct content items containing at least one accepted occurrence linked to this QID. Former field name was article_fq_f.

mention_count_l.description: Number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population. Former field name was mention_fq_f.

ner_type_pers_count_l.description: number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population, with NER type `pers`

ner_type_loc_count_l.description: number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population, with NER type `loc`

ner_type_org_count_l.description: number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population, with NER type `org`

ner_type_pressagency_count_l.description: number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population, with NER type `pressagency`

ner_type_radiostation_count_l.description: number of accepted mention occurrences linked to this QID across the indexed population, with NER type `radiostation`

^label_(?:en|fr|de|it|es|pt|nl|lb|rm|ca).description: Entity label in the specified supported language (ISO 639-1 code).
